summary: Fresh v1 build tested end-to-end. All 24 backend pytest tests PASSED including the slow AI redesign flow via Gemini Nano Banana (upload -> project -> redesign -> hotspots -> save design). Frontend: email/password login works, all 5 tabs (Home/Projects/Community/Pros/Profile) render, poll modal appears on first visit with dismiss, hero Start Project card is tappable, contractors list shows all 4 seed contractors with ratings/reviews/locations, community wall shows created posts, profile displays user info with edit/logout, AI chat FAB opens chat modal with input. No red screens, no critical console errors (only non-blocking react-native-web deprecation warnings for shadow* / pointerEvents).

issues: Non-blocking console deprecation warnings: react-native-web 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Consider migrating in a later polish pass.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Suppress deprecation warnings by migrating 'shadow*' style keys to boxShadow (react-native-web >=0.19) and moving pointerEvents onto style. Not functionality-blocking.
OPTIONAL: Contractor list cards do not expose a testable per-card testID (e.g., contractor-card-{id}). Cards navigate correctly by tap, but adding testID would help future automated tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 697-line file. Fine for v1 but consider splitting per-domain (auth, projects, wall, contractors, polls, chat) as feature set grows past ~800 lines.
resolve_user parses expires_at from ISO string on every request; consider storing as native datetime in Mongo for cheaper comparison.
put_object / get_object are sync requests wrapped in run_in_threadpool - correct pattern; no changes needed.
seed_data_creation: Registered user garden_test@example.com already existed. Test data created (TEST_ prefix): projects (TEST Garden, TEST NoPhoto, TEST Redesign with a real AI-generated redesign image + hotspots), wall post 'TEST_ Beautiful garden!', profile bio 'TEST_ love gardening', a review on GreenThumb Landscapes, and a poll vote on option 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Run full suite: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -v`. AI redesign test can take ~30-60s. Seeded contractors and active poll are auto-created on startup. Test user creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found in this iteration.
